cfg.language: UI language: Auto / English / 简体中文 / Русский. The panel switches immediately; restart the game to refresh config descriptions.
cfg.trajectory.bulletTrails: Draw the trajectory the bullet actually flies.
cfg.trajectory.trailAnimation: On = the trail is revealed point by point along the game's ballistic points, so you watch the bullet fly. Off = the complete trajectory is drawn the instant the shot is fired (no playback).
cfg.trajectory.animationSpeed: Trail playback speed: 1.0 = real time, 0.5 = half speed (slowing it down makes the drawing process easier to follow), 2.0 = double speed. Lower values keep each line on screen longer.
cfg.trajectory.trailLifetime: Seconds a trail or range stays on screen: 0 = stays forever, 2 = disappears after two seconds. The larger the value, the more lines are visible at the same time.
cfg.trajectory.maxTrails: How many trails may exist at once: 0 = no limit (an internal ceiling of 256 still applies), N = only the newest N are kept.
cfg.trajectory.colorBy: What the colour represents: Penetration / Damage / Off (use Base color).
cfg.trajectory.colorSelf: Trail colour for your own shots.
cfg.trajectory.colorScav: Trail colour for Scav / Savage shots.
cfg.trajectory.colorBoss: Trail colour for Boss (and followers) shots.
cfg.trajectory.stepPalette: Colours of the stepped scale: one hex value per step, comma separated. More steps = the remaining value is split into finer bands.
cfg.trajectory.penetrationScale: Absolute-value colouring scale: penetration at this value shows the last colour.
cfg.trajectory.damageScale: Absolute-value colouring scale: damage at this value shows the last colour.
cfg.trajectory.baseColor: Fallback colour when colouring is off (self/Scav/PMC/Boss use their own role colour; this is only used when the role is unknown).
cfg.trajectory.rigidbodyTrails: Record flight paths of grenades, flares and other rigid bodies.
cfg.trajectory.rigidbodyColor: Colour of rigid-body trails (also used by the grenade arc preview).
cfg.explosives.damageBands: On = the range is drawn as three shells (full damage / direct hit / any damage); off = one solid volume at the outer radius.
cfg.explosives.ranges: Draw explosion ranges of grenades and explosive rounds.
cfg.explosives.innerRange: Draw the full-damage range inside MinExplosionDistance.
cfg.explosives.stunRing: On = an extra ring marks the stun radius; off = no ring is drawn.
cfg.explosives.geometryClipping: On = the range is cut by walls and takes their shape; off = always a perfect sphere of the full radius.
cfg.explosives.geometryDensity: Latitude segments of the clipped mesh (8–40; longitude is doubled). Higher = the outline follows walls more closely and more rays are cast; lower = coarser outline, cheaper.
cfg.general.enabled: Master switch: turning it off draws nothing.
cfg.general.clearKey: Remove every trail and range from the screen.
cfg.general.onlyLocalShots: Draw only shots fired by the local player.
cfg.prediction.grenadeArc: Draw the throw arc while a grenade is primed (vanilla release point, speed and direction, measured per stance).
cfg.prediction.arcSteps: Integration steps of the throw arc (10–126): higher = smoother arc and more accurate landing point; a raycast is cast every third step.
cfg.prediction.trajectoryPreview: On = the trajectory of the held weapon is predicted and drawn every frame; off = nothing is drawn (nothing is recorded either way).
cfg.prediction.blastPreview: On = a flying grenade shows its blast range and the shape updates as it moves; off = ranges appear only after the detonation.
cfg.prediction.previewInner: Also preview the full-damage inner range.
cfg.debug.verboseLog: On = every hit and every decision is written to the log (large output); off = only the install summary.
cfg.debug.showOverlayPanel: Show the information panel on screen.
cfg.debug.panelX: Panel left edge in pixels from the screen left.
cfg.debug.panelY: Panel top edge in pixels from the screen top.
cfg.debug.panelBackground: Draw a dark box behind the text.
cfg.debug.reloadKey: Hotkey that reloads the implementation. Debug builds only.
